sameGrainComparisonContest.notes: The official static app federal JSON includes US PRESIDENT AND VICE PRESIDENT and US SENATOR reporting rows, but simple aggregation over the 284 federal rows does not reconcile to the SOS turnout total because the file mixes town and district reporting rows. A parser must model the row grain and reconcile against the certified canvass before enabling review rows.

The active turnout denominator remains EAC fallback even though a state-native SOS turnout JSON/PDF lead exists and reports different totals.
